MedDRA — Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities

title: Adverse Event Case Intake
short: Turns adverse event reports from emails, calls and forms into structured, coded safety cases.
ingredient: An intake assistant for pharmacovigilance teams
directions: Forward the report. Get the four minimum criteria checked, fields extracted, MedDRA terms suggested and seriousness flagged for the safety officer.
problem: Adverse event reports arrive as free text in emails, calls and forms; entering them into the safety database is slow and repetitive, and reporting timelines are strict.
why: Late or incomplete case processing risks missed safety signals and regulatory non-compliance.
solution: Checks the four minimum criteria for a valid case, extracts patient, drug, event and reporter details, suggests MedDRA coding, detects likely duplicates, and flags serious cases for fast reporting.
limitations: Needs a licensed MedDRA dictionary and validated systems
Causality and seriousness are confirmed by the safety officer
review: The safety officer confirms validity, coding, seriousness and causality before any report is submitted.
